questions.q: Prostitution is legal in parts of Nevada but illegal in ____, its biggest city.
questions.note: Clark County banned it. What happens in Vegas is a misdemeanor.

questions.q: Keith Richards told NME in 2007 that he had snorted ____ mixed with cocaine.
questions.note: His manager said it was a joke. The journalist says it wasn't.

questions.q: Cyclist Tom Simpson died on Mont Ventoux during the 1967 Tour de France with ____ in his jersey pocket.
questions.note: Two empty, one half full. He'd mixed them with brandy in a heatwave.

questions.q: Lenin's embalmed body has been on public display in Moscow since ____.
questions.note: Yearly soak in glycerol and potassium acetate. Looks better than most of us.

questions.q: The Mütter Museum also holds a collection of over 2,300 ____ that one doctor pulled out of patients' throats.
questions.note: Chevalier Jackson. Safety pins, coins, buttons, toys. All without surgery.

questions.q: On the Caribbean island of St. Kitts, vervet monkeys are known for stealing ____ from tourists on the beach.
questions.note: Researchers found the same split as humans: most drink socially, some binge, a few abstain.

questions.q: John Wayne Gacy performed at children's hospitals and parties as ____ the Clown.
questions.note: Also Patches. He designed the costumes himself.

questions.q: Dennis Rader, the BTK killer, was president of his ____ council when he was arrested in 2005.
questions.note: Christ Lutheran, Wichita. The church agenda on his floppy disk is what got him caught.
